أَضْلَعُ , applied to a man, [and accord. to the CK to a beast (دَابَّة) also,] Whose tooth is like the ضِلَع [or rib]; (Lth, O, K;) fem. ضَلْعَآءُ [perhaps applied to the tooth, but more probably, I think, to a woman]; (TA;) and pl. ضُلْعٌ. (K.) ―
-b2- Also, (O, [but accord. to the K “ or, ”]) Strong, thick, (O, K, TA,) large in make. (TA.) ―
-b3- And Stronger, or more powerful. (O, * TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
